title: City Heights – Residential Building Construction & Site Supervision
description: Led the on-site supervision of a 12-story residential building. Coordinated with contractors, ensured structural integrity, and managed quality control from foundation to finish.

title: Green River Overpass – Structural Design & Inspection
description: Contributed to the structural design of a 150-meter overpass. Performed load analysis, material selection, and conducted periodic inspections to ensure durability and safety.

title: Rural Connectivity – Road Expansion & Drainage Solutions
description: Executed the redesign and widening of 18 km of rural roads. Integrated sustainable drainage systems and ensured long-term durability against seasonal flooding.

title: SafeWater – Water Treatment Plant Construction Oversight
description: Supervised the construction of a municipal water treatment facility capable of processing 10 million liters per day. Ensured all civil works met environmental and safety standards.

title: SlopeGuard – Retaining Wall & Slope Stabilization Project
description: Designed and supervised the construction of reinforced retaining walls to prevent landslides in hilly terrain. Applied slope stability analysis to protect nearby settlements.
